name: Mail
description: The mail base: domain model, local cache and routes that every mail provider plugin attaches to

retention_days.description: How long a cached message is kept before the retention sweep drops it

max_rows_per_account.description: Upper bound on cached messages per account

body_cache_mb.description: Size cap for cached message bodies on disk, least recently used first

poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between poll ticks; a provider watch hint can kick a tick sooner

digest_enabled.description: Send one letter a day listing what is unread across every account. Send digest now in the Mail app works whether this is on or off

digest_time.description: Local time of day the digest goes out, as HH:MM

digest_max_items.description: Messages listed per account in the digest; the rest are counted

retention_days.label: Retention (days)
retention_days.help: Cached mail older than this is dropped

body_cache_mb.label: Body cache (MB)
body_cache_mb.help: Disk budget for cached message bodies

digest_enabled.label: Daily digest
digest_enabled.help: One letter a day with your unread mail. Send digest now still works when this is off

digest_time.label: Digest time
digest_time.help: Local time the digest is sent, as HH:MM
